subject: Harness judge: review T6 smoke + runbook attempt
description: Single-attempt review (self-learn-judge, single-attempt review mode) of T6 — the feature merge gate. Rubric: (1) smoke.py asserts the REAL mechanism (ingestion → blind keep → /task/context returns evidence not distractor → our-way correct, cold fails) and actually RUNS GREEN against the live daemon (re-run it via the embeddable python full path). (2) README/APPLY are accurate: correct licenses (LoCoMo CC BY-NC not committed, LongMemEval MIT), correct run procedure, and the honest caveats present (candidate-gen still embeds; createEdge finding; isolated-ws prune; Windows claude -p). (3) .gitignore now covers bench/agent-memory/report.{json,md}. (4) stdlib-only; scope = smoke.py + README.md + APPLY.md + .gitignore; style. Under the agent-memory-bench feature: APPROVE → merge_attempt into feature; KICK BACK → set_status failed + wired record_decision. Never force-merge.
